verdict.rationale: Zapier documents public REST APIs: Actions, Connections and Trigger Inbox, plus a Workflow API. It publishes OpenAPI 3.1 specs per API, an RFC 9727 API catalog and interactive try-it playgrounds, alongside an SDK for executing actions programmatically. The probe's 404s at generic openapi paths do not contradict this, because the specs are served under /api-reference/specs/. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving Zapier via the API, and a published stability/deprecation policy for the public REST APIs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Each API in the sidebar includes an interactive playground where you can make live requests. Select an endpoint, fill in the parameters, and run it directly from the browser
Use Zapier's Workflow API and 9,000 integrations to power a built-in automation experience, integration marketplace, or AI workflows.
Install @zapier/zapier-sdk via npm, authenticate with OAuth or client credentials, and execute actions across 9,000+ apps.
